title: Commission approves €170 million Bulgarian State aid for farmers facing increased fuel and fertiliser prices
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 02 Oct 2026 The European Commission has approved a €170 million Bulgarian State aid scheme for farmers facing increased fuel and fertiliser prices due to the Middle East crisis.

title: Commission finds Polish support for MAN Trucks factory expansion incompatible State aid
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 05 Oct 2026 The European Commission has concluded that Poland's plan to support the extension of capacity of a factory of truck producer MAN Trucks Sp. z o. o. in Niepołomice in the Małopolskie region is not in line with EU State aid rules. Therefore, Poland cannot disburse the aid.

title: Commission registers European Citizens' Initiative for sovereign European AI domains
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 06 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission registered the European Citizens' Initiative (ECI) entitled ‘Creation of a European Digital Space (.IA) for Sovereign AI Governance'.

title: Eurobarometer survey highlights growing use of AI in European companies
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 14 Oct 2026 European businesses rely increasingly on artificial intelligence (AI). That is what the results of the latest Eurobarometer survey showed, published today.

title: Commission disburses €2.86 billion to Ukraine for drones, missiles and urgent battlefield needs
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 14 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission disbursed €2.86 billion to Ukraine under the defence component of the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan. The funding will go towards drones, air defence systems, missiles, radars, electronic warfare systems and ammunitions.
